# An email-constrained private root: root_cert (self-signed, serial 1) carries a critical nameConstraints extension permitting only email:corp.example.
# Every leaf is signed directly by the root, carries EKU serverAuth+clientAuth, and is valid 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, ecdsa-with-SHA256, P-256, keys not stored.
#   email_in_scope_leaf_cert         serial 2  subject CN + emailAddress=user@corp.example, no subjectAltName: accepted
#   email_out_of_scope_leaf_cert     serial 3  subject CN + emailAddress=admin@forbidden.test, no subjectAltName: refused
#   email_san_out_of_scope_leaf_cert serial 4  subject CN only, subjectAltName rfc822Name admin@forbidden.test: refused
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.6.1 (NB=20200101000000Z, NA=20991231000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key   (each certificate)
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Email NC Root" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA
#     -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" -addext "subjectKeyIdentifier=hash"
#     -addext "nameConstraints=critical,permitted;email:corp.example" -out root.pem
#   openssl req -new -key X.key -subj "<subject>" -out X.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in X.csr -CA root.pem -CAkey root.key -set_serial N -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile X.ext -out X.pem
#     X.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth,clientAuth / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash /
#            authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid, plus subjectAltName=email:admin@forbidden.test for the SAN leaf only
#   openssl verify -CAfile root.pem X.pem: the in-scope leaf is OK; the other two fail with error 47 (permitted subtree violation)
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
email_in_scope_leaf_
email_out_of_scope_leaf_
email_san_out_of_scope_leaf_
